verdict.rationale: GitCafe serves a site-wide llms.txt, which a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200. It also documents per-repository `/<owner>/<repo>/llms.txt` summaries and says every guide can be read as Markdown for coding agents, so agents can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and a working docs.md index (probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Every guide, and most repository pages, can be read as Markdown. This is handy for scripts, coding agents and anything that prefers text to HTML.
`/<owner>/<repo>/llms.txt` summarizes a repository: its description, default branch, root files, the start of its README, and links to its code, history, issues and pull requests.
